description: Surface Optimization of the (100) Surface of MgO (Cubic, Fm-3m) and Surface Energy Calculation
user_prompt: Optimize the (100) surface of magnesium oxide MgO (cubic, Fm-3m) and calculate the surface energy. Report the final surface energy in J/m^2.

references: Bajdich, Norskov & Vojvodic, Phys. Rev. B 91, 155401 (2015)
method.modeling: rock-salt MgO (Fm-3m) non-polar (100) surface; symmetric slab (>= 4-5 MgO layers, converged), vacuum >= 15 A, surface relaxed.
method.rationale: Value 1.02 J/m^2 is the PBE MgO(100) surface energy from Broqvist et al. 2004 (ultrasoft pseudopotentials rather than the benchmark PAW). PBE underestimates the experimental ~1.04 J/m^2 surface energy, so the case is graded against the PBE value, not experiment. MgO(100) is the non-polar Tasker type-1 facet. Tolerance +/-0.20 J/m^2 (absolute) covers inter-setup PBE scatter (slab thickness, k-mesh, the lattice constant used for the cell area); larger deviations usually signal an unconverged slab.
